body:
Switching to 3D globe mode takes several seconds due to DOM destruction/recreation triggering full WebGL re-initialization.

## Approaches Implemented

This PR includes multiple approaches for comparison and testing:

### Approach 1: CSS Visibility Toggle (commit ec326ca)
Keeps both 2D and 3D figures in DOM, toggles visibility via CSS display property.

```julia
# Use Observable with on() callbacks instead of @lift to avoid synchronous update issues
map_2d_style = Observable(globe_3d[] ? 
    Bonito.Styles("display" => "none") : 
    Bonito.Styles("display" => "block", "width" => "100%", "height" => "100%"))
map_3d_style = Observable(globe_3d[] ? 
    Bonito.Styles("display" => "block", "width" => "100%", "height" => "100%") : 
    Bonito.Styles("display" => "none"))

on(globe_3d) do is_3d
    map_2d_style[] = is_3d ? 
        Bonito.Styles("display" => "none") : 
        Bonito.Styles("display" => "block", "width" => "100%", "height" => "100%")
    map_3d_style[] = is_3d ? 
        Bonito.Styles("display" => "block", "width" => "100%", "height" => "100%") : 
        Bonito.Styles("display" => "none")
end

map_2d_card = Bonito.DOM.div(Bonito.Card(fig; shadow_size = "0"); style = map_2d_style)
map_3d_card = Bonito.DOM.div(Bonito.Card(fig_3d; shadow_size = "0"); style = map_3d_style)
```

### Approach 2: Simplified Observable Swap (commit e6a3c82)
Simpler implementation without CSS complexity, uses direct Observable-based card switching.

```julia
# Simple Observable-based card switching
map_card = Observable(globe_3d[] ? Bonito.Card(fig_3d; shadow_size = "0") : Bonito.Card(fig; shadow_size = "0"))

on(globe_3d) do is_3d
    map_card[] = is_3d ? Bonito.Card(fig_3d; shadow_size = "0") : Bonito.Card(fig; shadow_size = "0")
end
```

### Approach 3: Makie.Box Visibility (commit bd55714)
Pure Makie implementation using Box blocks with native visibility control - no CSS or figure swapping needed.

```julia
# Create single Figure with two Box blocks at same position [1,1]
box_2d = Box(fig[1, 1], tellwidth=true, tellheight=true)
box_2d.visible = !globe_3d[]

box_3d = Box(fig[1, 1], tellwidth=true, tellheight=true)
box_3d.visible = globe_3d[]

# Toggle visibility
on(globe_3d) do is_3d
    box_2d.visible = !is_3d
    box_3d.visible = is_3d
end
```

## Changes Made

- Replaced `@lift` macro with `Observable()` and `on()` callbacks throughout to avoid synchronous update issues
- Applied same pattern to profile figure switching for consistency
- Updated NEWS.md to document performance improvements
- Created three alternative implementations for performance testing
- Added `create_combined_figure_with_boxes()` function in `src/figures.jl` demonstrating Makie.Box approach
- Added demo file `examples/box_visibility_demo.jl` showing the Box.visible pattern

**Before:**
```julia
# Bonito destroys/recreates DOM on every toggle
map_fig = @lift($(globe_3d) ? fig_3d : fig)
map_card = Bonito.Card(map_fig; shadow_size = "0")
```

All three approaches eliminate the `@lift` macro and use Observable-based updates. The Makie.Box approach (Approach 3) is the cleanest solution, using pure Makie visibility control without CSS manipulation or DOM operations. Testing will determine which approach provides the best performance in practice.
